mapper.select: select cpi.ITEM_NM, cpi.ITEM_WEIGHT, cpid.DIVISION, cpid.SUBJECT_NO , cpid.ITEM_NO, GROUP_CONCAT(cpid.ITEM_SCORE) as ITEM_SCORE, GROUP_CONCAT(IFNULL(cpid.ITEM_STANDARD1,'null')) as ITEM_STANDARD1 , GROUP_CONCAT(IFNULL(cpid.OPERATOR1,'null')) as OPERATOR1 , GROUP_CONCAT(IFNULL(cpid.ITEM_STANDARD2,'null')) as ITEM_STANDARD2 , GROUP_CONCAT(IFNULL(cpid.OPERATOR2,'null')) as OPERATOR2 from CBCI_PRIZM_ITEM_DETAIL cpid left join CBCI_PRIZM_ITEM cpi on cpid.DIVISION =cpi.DIVISION and cpid.SUBJECT_NO = cpi.SUBJECT_NO and cpid.ITEM_NO = cpi.ITEM_NO where cpid.DIVISION = ${DIVISION} group by cpid.SUBJECT_NO, cpid.ITEM_NO order by cpid.DIVISION, cpid.SUBJECT_NO, cpid.ITEM_NO, cpid.ITEM_SCORE ASC

select cpig.DIVISION , cpig.GRADE_NO , cpig.GRADE_NM , FLOOR(cpig.ITEM_STANDARD1) as ITEM_STANDARD1 , cpig.OPERATOR1 , FLOOR(cpig.ITEM_STANDARD2) as ITEM_STANDARD2 , cpig.OPERATOR2 from CBCI_PRIZM_ITEM_GRADE cpig where DIVISION =#{DIVISION} order by cpig.DIVISION , cpig.GRADE_NO ASC
